sections.indications:
It is used in aphrodisiac therapy.

sections.side_effects:
This medicine should only be taken under strict medical supervision.

fullContent:
Siddha Makardhwaj 
 Reference: Rasa Tarangini. 
 Siddha Makardhwaj is an Ayurvedic medicine, with herbal and mineral ingredients, in tablet form. It balances the Tridosha – Vata, Pitta and Kapha in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Parada – Purified and processed Mercury – 160 grams 
 Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur – 80 grams 
 Swarna Bhasma – Gold Bhasma – 40 grams 
 
 Method of preparation 
 The above combination of minerals are subjected to a process called as Kupipakva method i.e. Heating of all ingredients with kajjali (sulphur and mercury) to method to obtain Siddha Makardhwaj. 
 Dosage 
 125 mg to 250 mg – 1 – 2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. This medicine is traditionally administered along with milk. 
 Indications 
 
 It is used in aphrodisiac therapy. 
 It is also used in convalescent therapy. 
 It is used for rejuvenation and anti-aging treatment. 
 
 Side effects 
 
 This medicine should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 
 Over dosage with this medicine may result in tremors, dizziness etc. 
 It is to be avoided in children and pregnant ladies. 
 Take this medicine only in the prescribed dose and for the prescribed period of time. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
